global._doc_wg_bind_ip: Caddy's WG IP — every public *.diegonmarcos.com site block dual-binds to (0.0.0.0, wg_bind_ip) so Hickory's *.diegonmarcos.com → 10.0.0.1 fast-path lands on the same routing table the public listener uses. Without this, WG-internal traffic hits the *:443 listener that's shadowed by the more-specific 10.0.0.1:443 listener (created by *.app blocks), and unmatched hosts get an empty 200 response.
